preconditions.description: The number of grooms n must be between 1 and 100.
The number of times the princess said 'Oh...' must be between 0 and 15.
The number of times the princess exclaimed 'Wow!' must be between 0 and 15.
The number of grooms n must be greater than the sum of a and b.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers representing the fortunes of the grooms.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(t) <= 50000 for t in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each groom's fortune must be an integer between 1 and 50000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not (a + b < n) else True
postconditions.description: If no valid sequence exists, output -1; otherwise, output a valid sequence.
